files.title: Our World in Data — CO2 and Greenhouse Gas Emissions dataset (trimmed)
files.trim: Rows: the 13 corridor countries, 6 external countries (ISO3) and 'European Union (27)'; years 2000-2024. Columns: country, year, iso_code, population, gdp, co2, co2_per_capita, coal_co2.
files.notes: gdp is OWID's Maddison-based series in international-$ (2011 prices).
